items.title: Politician who investigated spyware abuses had his phone hacked with Pegasus spyware | TechCrunch
items.summary: A government customer of NSO Group used the company's Pegasus spyware to hack into the phone of a European politician, who at the time was serving on an EU committee tasked with investigating the spyware industry.
